description: Get the current FAA traffic management status for one or more US airports: a headline status, every active event (ground stop, Ground Delay Program with its delay profile, arrival or departure delay, closure, deicing) with reason and times, and the runway configuration and airport arrival rate. Every row carries the airport's ARTCC, and its coordinates come from the feed when the airport is listed (absent when the feed omits them) and from the NASR directory otherwise; both place a departure airport against a program's includedFacilities and departureScopeNm. Airports are FAA 3-character identifiers (SEA, ORD, JFK) or their ICAO codes (KSEA, PHNL); a code that names no US airport is rejected. The FAA feed lists only airports with an active event, so a known airport absent from it returns status no_active_events, and runway configuration is available only for listed airports.

airports.description: 1–25 US airports, each a 3-character FAA location identifier (SEA, ORD, 0S9) or its ICAO code (KSEA, PHNL, TJSJ), case-insensitive; a comma-separated string is also accepted. City and airport names are not accepted.

items.description: US airport: 3-character FAA identifier (SEA) or its ICAO code (KSEA); trimmed and uppercased before validation.

name: faa_delays_get_airport_status

airports.description: One row per requested airport, in request order, duplicates dropped.

airportName.description: Airport name: the feed name when listed, else the FAA NASR directory name. It shows which airport the requested code resolved to.

maxMinutes.description: Upper bound of the delay band in minutes.

minMinutes.description: Lower bound of the delay band in minutes (the FAA reports delays in 15-minute bands).

updatedAt.description: When the FAA last updated this delay (UTC ISO); an entry can outlive the delay.

artcc.description: Air Route Traffic Control Center responsible for the airport, from the NASR directory (ZSE), in the form a program's includedFacilities lists ARTCCs. A few airports belong to a foreign or oceanic facility (ZVR, NZZO); faa_delays_list_reference topic artccs decodes every code.

closure.description: Airport closed to all operations; text lists exceptions.

closureNotam.description: NOTAM-worded closure or restriction, often narrow (for example closed to transient GA).

deicing.description: A formal deicing program is in effect.

departureDelay.description: Active departure delay (taxi or gate holds).

maxMinutes.description: Upper bound of the delay band in minutes.

minMinutes.description: Lower bound of the delay band in minutes (the FAA reports delays in 15-minute bands).

updatedAt.description: When the FAA last updated this delay (UTC ISO); an entry can outlive the delay.

groundDelayProgram.description: Active Ground Delay Program: flights to this airport receive assigned departure delays.

advisory.description: Reference to the ATCSCC advisory behind this item, absent when the FAA feed links none. For the full text, call faa_delays_get_advisory with number as advisory_number and date as date.

number.description: ATCSCC advisory number; numbers restart at 1 each UTC day.

url.description: Server-built advisory URL, the page faa_delays_get_advisory reads for this number and date.

delayProfile.description: Delay trend: average assigned delay for each 15-minute arrival interval of the program.

averageDelayMinutes.description: Average assigned delay per consecutive 15-minute arrival interval, in order.

items.description: Average delay in minutes for one 15-minute arrival interval.

intervalMinutes.description: Length of each interval in minutes; always 15.

startTime.description: UTC ISO start of the first 15-minute interval. The FAA aligns intervals to the quarter hour, so it can precede the program start by up to 14 minutes.

departureScopeNm.description: Departure scope: departures within this many nautical miles are included.

includedFacilities.description: Departure facilities in scope: ARTCC codes, in the form of each row's artcc, and 4-character ICAO codes for named airports, such as Canadian airports.

items.description: ARTCC code, as in artcc, or 4-character ICAO airport code.

includedFlights.description: Flights included, such as ALL CONTIGUOUS US DEP (FAA-authored text).

programStartTime.description: When the program began, before any revision (UTC ISO).

startTime.description: Start of the current revision's arrival window (UTC ISO); a revised program keeps its earlier start in programStartTime.

groundStop.description: Active ground stop: flights to this airport are held at their departure airports.

advisory.description: Reference to the ATCSCC advisory behind this item, absent when the FAA feed links none. For the full text, call faa_delays_get_advisory with number as advisory_number and date as date.

number.description: ATCSCC advisory number; numbers restart at 1 each UTC day.

url.description: Server-built advisory URL, the page faa_delays_get_advisory reads for this number and date.

includedFacilities.description: Departure facilities in scope: ARTCC codes for a tier-scoped stop, in the form of each row's artcc, and 4-character ICAO codes for named airports.

items.description: ARTCC code, as in artcc, or 4-character ICAO airport code.

includedFlights.description: Flights included, such as ALL CONTIGUOUS US DEP (FAA-authored text).

probabilityOfExtension.description: Likelihood the stop is extended: low <30 %, medium 30–60 %, high >60 % per the FAA.

isPacingAirport.description: Whether the FAA tracks this as a pacing airport; omitted when that list could not be read.

latitude.description: Latitude in decimal degrees: the feed's value for a listed airport, else the NASR directory's (4 decimal places).

listedInFeed.description: Whether the FAA feed lists this airport; it lists only airports with an active event.

longitude.description: Longitude in decimal degrees: the feed's value for a listed airport, else the NASR directory's (4 decimal places).

requestedAs.description: The code as submitted (an ICAO code), present only when it differs from airportId.

runwayConfiguration.description: Runway configuration and arrival rate; reported only for airports the feed lists.

arrivalRatePerHour.description: Airport arrival rate (AAR): arrivals the airport accepts per hour.

reportedAt.description: When the FAA recorded this configuration (UTC ISO).

state.description: State or territory code from the NASR directory.

status.description: Headline status, first match wins: closed (airport closure) → ground_stop → ground_delay_program → delays (arrival or departure delay) → restrictions_only (listed with only a closure NOTAM, deicing, or runway configuration) → no_active_events (absent from the feed: no FAA program, which does not guarantee on-time flights).

timezone.description: IANA-style time zone the FAA assigns to a pacing airport (US/Pacific).

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `unknown_airport`: A requested code is not a 3-character identifier in the FAA NASR airport directory, or a 4-character code that is not the ICAO code of one. `feed_unavailable`: NAS Status unreachable, 5xx, an attempt timeout, or an HTML maintenance page, after retries. `upstream_rate_limited`: The FAA returned 429 after retries, or this server's queue to the FAA would wait past 10 s while backing off from an FAA 429. `retry_deadline_exceeded`: The 20 s retry budget ran out. `pacer_shed`: This server's own queue to the FAA would wait past 10 s with no FAA 429 backoff in effect. `feed_contract_changed`: The feed path returned 404/410, or a body whose shape this server no longer recognizes. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

fetchedAt.description: When this server fetched the snapshot from the FAA (UTC ISO); with the 60 s cache it can trail the call by up to a minute.

notice.description: Guidance on quiet results, stale delay entries, or partial data.

title: Get FAA Airport Status
